principles: No single keyword is sufficient for an observed-event classification.
PV relevance and ICSR completeness are evaluated separately.
Potentially serious observed or ambiguous events are routed to human review to reduce false negatives.
Generated or normalized terminology is a candidate only and never establishes causality, reportability, or validated MedDRA coding.
Hypothetical, informational, negated, anticipated, and temporally unrelated content is retained for audit but is not treated as an observed case.
